The four AssemblyAI documents' SDK-grouped components carry synthetic inline object and enum descendants into their own package; separate referenced components retain their own placement. Original residual: document-acceptance/README.md.

The patterned and unpatterned datetime type overrides write datetime.datetime; boolean literal overrides retain their prior behavior and canonical headers take precedence. This residual was exposed by Nussknacker.
Explicit enum casing preserves publisher-declared digit separators in member and visitor names; ordinary enum values keep the existing derived spelling. This residual was exposed by AssemblyAI.

A single-reference allOf without own fields is an alias even with explicit object type or additionalProperties false; own properties still produce an inherited model. This residual was exposed by AssemblyAI.

An unsplit octet-stream request wins over unused multipart alternatives; unused multipart properties cannot collide with actual query arguments. A split or selected multipart body still receives collision validation. This residual was exposed by Inferna.
The constant-header block rule held only as a file's sole difference; a block now composes with other departures in one reference.md, with every other difference left for its own rule.
The nullable-items rule held only for a whole file and by parameter name; one reference.md type line now composes, so a same-named plain parameter keeps its type.
The closed-empty-object region required both sides' lines to start together; one placeholder between the same neighbours now composes with a line-count shift above it.
The request-alias rule read only a model's own fields and compared typing.Sequence to the reference's typing.List; it now reads inherited fields and the documented spelling.
A repaired one-item list too long for one line is judged as if it stood on Fern's one line.
A promoted date-time header's YOUR_ placeholder contradicts its dt.datetime annotation; crozier passes a datetime, including from a sub-client docstring whose wrapper holds the annotation.
A promoted format: date-time header is typed dt.datetime and written with str().
Streaming and binary-download methods raised a bare ApiError where the import was aliased beside a component of that name, a NameError at runtime; they now raise the alias.
A titled component declaring properties beside an allOf over a $ref works its docstring call own fields first; an untitled one keeps its base's first.

A body component that is only allOf one $ref with empty properties is an alias, kept beside the method, and with no parameters collapses to a bare type name that sends no content-type whatever its title.
A multipart part of format json-string is JSON-encoded.

The discriminant declared beside a discriminated union's members is no shared field and its type is never written; a union declaring nothing else has no Base.
A string enum declared beside an undiscriminated component union's alternatives is no part of the alias, but its type is still written, unused, as the certified pair writes it.
An inline urlencoded allOf of $ref parents and plain objects lowers to their fields rather than to none, inline members first, with the worked call and reference listing the parents' first.
A flattened body honours a bare required member of its allOf, requiring the parent's optional fields and listing them first.
A multipart object whose oneOf sits beside its properties loses them: the method takes no part and sends data={} and files={}, as the certified pair does.
An inline allOf of a $ref and a typeless required-only member is the parent's object with those names required, in the parent's order and with its description.
An example value its enum does not declare is worked as the enum's first member, as the certified pair works it, in place of writing the undeclared string.
A documented schema example drops the content-type header only while the schema survives; one flattened away keeps it.
x-fern-type optional<datetime> is a datetime override; the schema's nullable type carries the optionality.
A group declared beside a sole inline allOf member is lost in the merge, and the component stays at the root, as the certified pair writes it.

A $ref oneOf branch of an allOf member lends its properties in branch order, and a docstring passes a flattened parent's fields in declaration order.

Markdown examples list a base's own fields ahead of that base's bases on a nested model.

An urlencoded form and header on an operation answering no JSON keep the author's declared values over the pair's fallback placeholders; ruling 2 principle.
